_about: Curated EIC batch calendar and Work Programme budgets that the Funding & Tenders Portal does not carry. The portal gives the EIC Accelerator topic a budget of 0 and a single end date, while the Work Programme sets monthly short-proposal batches, six full-proposal batches and a EUR 634M budget. Read by services/eic_call_calendar.py (feed 'next batch' line) and scripts/backfill_call_budgets.py (budget fallback when the portal says zero).
_source: EIC Work Programme 2026, Commission Decision C(2026) 4080, version of 17 June 2026 (Sections V, VI, VII and Annex 1); EIC call pages and Funding & Tenders Portal topic records, read 8 October 2026.
_review_by: When the 2027 EIC Work Programme is adopted, or when scripts/check_eic_sources.py reports a new Work Programme version.

_source_versions._note: What Brubru's EIC guides, templates and this calendar were last checked against. scripts/check_eic_sources.py compares these with the live sources; after updating the guides, run it with --accept to store the new values.
